cases.name: Revision accuracy
cases.notes: Ten independent dots report the same statement with different truth values; the commons must match NAL revision exactly.

cases.name: Message delivery
cases.notes: Operator to dot: send a message and read it back from the dot's inbox.

cases.name: Model gateway overhead
cases.notes: Calls to the offline mock model through the gateway: metering, budget and rate checks included.

cases.name: Goal claim race
cases.notes: Eight dots race to claim each of 25 goals at the same moment; exactly one may win each.

cases.name: Echo storm
cases.notes: One dot publishes a belief; nine dots read it and republish it five times each. Echoes must not raise confidence. The dashed line is what naive revision would have done.

cases.name: Independent corroboration
cases.notes: Nine dots observe the same thing without reading each other. Independent evidence should raise confidence, exactly as NAL predicts: the guard against echoes must not block real corroboration.

cases.name: Self-repetition
cases.notes: One dot says the same thing 50 times. Confidence must stay where it started.

cases.name: Retry storm
cases.notes: A dot stuck in a loop fires 200 model calls as fast as it can. The calls-per-minute ceiling (60) must cut it off.

cases.name: Spend runaway
cases.notes: A dot on a paid model ($3/$15 per M tokens) with a $0.25 budget keeps calling. Spend must never pass the budget: each call's worst case is reserved before it is made.

cases.name: Abandoned goal recovery
cases.notes: posted: open; claimed by dot 1: claimed; dot 1 went silent: open; claimed by dot 2: claimed; dot 2 waits on a person: waiting; lease check while waiting: waiting; reply arrived: claimed; dot 2 finished: done

series.name: goal state (0 open, 1 claimed, 2 waiting, 4 done)

cases.name: Subgoal explosion
cases.notes: A dot tries to split one goal into 100 subgoals and nest them 10 deep. Splitting must stop at 12 wide and 3 deep.

cases.name: Paid model without a budget
cases.notes: Refusals that must happen before any money moves: no budget, no price.
